name: hr-pro-bridge
description: On-premise agent that relays Hikvision biometric punches to the live HR Pro server
author: Unisoftwares Inc

scripts.build: npm run build:win && npm run build:mac
scripts.build:mac: pkg . --targets node22-macos-x64 --output dist/HRProBridge-macos-intel && pkg . --targets node22-macos-arm64 --no-bytecode --public --output dist/HRProBridge-macos-apple-silicon
